name: 085.3 — a size is a size
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 085.3: every size the API hands back is {w=, h=}, the keys it retired raise naming their replacement, a place and a pixel are unmoved, a size read passes straight back into a write while an {x=, y=} under size is refused, and a mesh names its span extent. Ships its own image and model, so it asks nothing of the world.
